QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] No Free Trade
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bTonero#k of the Shadowdealers at the #bMerchant Meet-Up#k.
QuestInfo.1: Tonero of the Shadowdealers said he always wanted to do business with the Nova. When you said you're looking for an amplifier, he said it would be possible if you can get him #b10 Specter Cores#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the Specter Cores to Tonero. He was surprised at your unexpected speed.
